theorem mvcc.leaseItemsOf_putKv {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s) (r : w64) (k v :
    GoString) (l : w64) (it : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem) : mvcc.leaseItemsOf (putKv
    r k v l s) !! it = if it.Key' = k then if l = W64 0 then none else some l else mvcc.leaseItemsOf
    s !! it

theorem mvcc.leaseDelKeys_mem {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s) (id : w64) (k :
    GoString) : k ∈ mvcc.leaseDelKeys s id ↔ mvcc.leaseItemsOf s !! { Key' := k } = some id

def mvcc.pendItems (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : GMap
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem w64 :=
  mvcc.leaseItemsOf (mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑(List.length ilog)) (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) pend)

theorem mvcc.findKey_iff_sorted {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s) (k : GoString)
    (v : EtcdKv) : mvcc.findKey k s = some v ↔ v ∈ s ∧ v.key = k

def mvcc.leaseDels (s : List EtcdKv) (id : w64) : List mvcc.Change :=
  List.map mvcc.Change.del (mvcc.leaseDelKeys s id)

theorem mvcc.leaseItemsOf_zero (s : List EtcdKv) (h : ∀ (kv : EtcdKv), kv ∈ s → kv.lease = W64 0) :
    mvcc.leaseItemsOf s = ∅

theorem mvcc.sorted_key_unique {s : List EtcdKv} : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s → ∀ {v w : EtcdKv}, v
    ∈ s → w ∈ s → v.key = w.key → v = w

theorem mvcc.leaseDels_mem {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s) (id : w64) (c :
    mvcc.Change) : c ∈ mvcc.leaseDels s id ↔ ∃ k, c = mvcc.Change.del k ∧ mvcc.leaseItemsOf s !! {
    Key' := k } = some id

theorem mvcc.leaseDels_isDel (s : List EtcdKv) (id : w64) (c : mvcc.Change) : c ∈ mvcc.leaseDels s
    id → c.isDel = true

theorem mvcc.leaseItemsOf_ne_zero (s : List EtcdKv) (it : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem)
    : mvcc.leaseItemsOf s !! it ≠ some (W64 0)

theorem mvcc.eq_of_lt_sorted_mem {l₁ l₂ : List GoString} : List.Pairwise go.GoStringLt l₁ →
    List.Pairwise go.GoStringLt l₂ → (∀ (x : GoString), x ∈ l₁ ↔ x ∈ l₂) → l₁ = l₂

def mvcc.leaseItemsOf (s : List EtcdKv) : GMap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem w64 :=
  { lookup := fun it => (mvcc.findKey it.Key' s).bind mvcc.kvLease, finite := ⋯ }

theorem mvcc.leaseItemsOf_getD (s : List EtcdKv) (it : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem) (l
    : w64) (h : (mvcc.leaseItemsOf s !! it).getD (W64 0) = l) : mvcc.leaseItemsOf s !! it = if l =
    W64 0 then none else some l

theorem mvcc.pendItems_absent (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (k : GoString) (hwf :
    mvcc.LogWf (ilog ++ [pend])) (hlen : List.length (ilog ++ [pend]) < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List
    mvcc.Change), cs ∈ ilog ++ [pend] → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hg : mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey
    (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])) k) (W64 ↑(List.length ilog)) = none) : mvcc.pendItems ilog pend !!
    { Key' := k } = none

theorem mvcc.leaseItemsOf_dels (r : w64) (ks : List GoString) (s : List EtcdKv) (it :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem) : mvcc.leaseItemsOf (mvcc.applyChanges r s (List.map
    mvcc.Change.del ks)) !! it = if it.Key' ∈ ks then none else mvcc.leaseItemsOf s !! it

theorem mvcc.filter_key_sorted (k : GoString) (s : List EtcdKv) : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s →
    List.map EtcdKv.key (List.filter (fun v => decide (v.key = k)) s) = if (mvcc.findKey k s).isSome
    = true then [k] else []

theorem mvcc.leaseItemsOf_lookup (s : List EtcdKv) (it : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem)
    : mvcc.leaseItemsOf s !! it = (mvcc.findKey it.Key' s).bind mvcc.kvLease

theorem mvcc.leaseItemsOf_del (s : List EtcdKv) (k : GoString) (it :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem) : mvcc.leaseItemsOf (List.filter (fun x => !decide
    (x.key = k)) s) !! it = if it.Key' = k then none else mvcc.leaseItemsOf s !! it

def mvcc.leaseDelKeys (s : List EtcdKv) (id : w64) : List GoString :=
  if id = W64 0 then [] else List.map EtcdKv.key (List.filter (fun v => decide (v.lease = id)) s)

def mvcc.kvLease (kv : EtcdKv) : Option w64 :=
  if kv.lease = W64 0 then none else some kv.lease

theorem mvcc.leaseDelKeys_sorted {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s) (id : w64) :
    List.Pairwise go.GoStringLt (mvcc.leaseDelKeys s id)

theorem mvcc.leaseDelKeys_eq {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s) (id : w64) (ks :
    List GoString) (hnd : ks.Nodup) (hmem : ∀ (k : GoString), k ∈ ks ↔ mvcc.leaseItemsOf s !! { Key'
    := k } = some id) (hsort : ∀ (i j : Nat) (ki kj : GoString), ks[i]? = some ki → ks[j]? = some kj
    → i < j → go.GoStringLe ki kj) : ks = mvcc.leaseDelKeys s id

theorem mvcc.leaseItem_eq_iff (it : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem) (k : GoString) : it =
    { Key' := k } ↔ it.Key' = k
